cases.prompt: Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to solve a one-variable linear equation with integer coefficients and one solution.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to factorise a monic quadratic with two distinct integer roots.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to expand the product of two binomials with integer terms.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to differentiate a cubic polynomial with integer coefficients.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to find the determinant of a two by two matrix with integer entries.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to simplify a rational expression with integer coefficients and one variable.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to evaluate an arithmetic expression with brackets and the usual order of operations.
Create a short prose mathematics word problem about buying two items and receiving change. Use anchored numbers for the prices and the amount paid, and ask for one computed result.
Create a mathematics question that asks the learner to prove that the sum of two even integers is always even.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to find all eigenvalues of a three by three matrix with integer entries.
Create a mathematics multiple-choice question that asks the learner to evaluate a one-sided limit of a rational function at a finite point.
Create a mathematics word problem about drawing two counters without replacement and ask the learner for the probability that both counters have the same colour.
